a3_scope: Additive opt-in prepared-operation planner + D059 read-only food forecast. A3 never writes disk, never owns a second clock/inventory, and never auto-collects or auto-chains.

run_real_utc.rule: run_expires_at_unix == run_started_at_unix + 1209600; offline settlement clamps to expiry; expiry is non-destructive and A0 owns the run-end UI.

world_calendar.rule: A3 echoes the authenticated continuous world-calendar projection and reports elapsed_world_us, but never converts it into work, loot, cooldown, crop, or weather effects. Rate/year length is NOT_USER_LOCKED.

operation_clock.rule: Only explicitly armed, already-paid, allowlisted jobs may consume real elapsed seconds. V5 ACTIVE source cooldowns remain ACTIVE-only.

mount_order: 1. A0 SaveService loads/pins the A3 adapter and preserves survival_economy.offline (optional; absent => empty, no retroactive credit).
3. economy_service.load_catalog() if called separately; this clears the offline host by design.
5. Player pays for a job through existing enqueue/research APIs, then explicitly arms it with arm_offline_operation(job_id,event_id).
6. On return, A0 reads one authenticated projection, calls plan_offline_operations(request), and commits only through SaveService.transact_once using proposal_id as the idempotency key.
7. Inside that mutator A0 calls apply_offline_operation_plan(candidate, proposal, request). A3 re-plans from the candidate and ignores proposal-supplied deltas.
8. Player collects ready output through existing collect(); full bag keeps output in job escrow.

api.configure_offline_time_host: (host: Callable) -> bool; host() must return the exact authenticated projection dictionary. Absent/invalid host fails closed.
api.arm_offline_operation: (job_id: String, event_id: String) -> Dictionary; existing SaveService transaction; records custody only, no progress.
api.apply_offline_operation_plan: (candidate: Dictionary, proposal: Dictionary, request: Variant) -> Dictionary; pure candidate transform for A0's SaveService mutator.
api.forecast_offline_food: (request: Variant, needs: Variant) -> Dictionary; READ-ONLY D059 item-debit forecast.
api.plan_tool_use: (request: Variant) -> Dictionary; V5 A0 handoff callable now implemented, read-only.
api.apply_tool_use_plan: (candidate: Dictionary, plan: Dictionary) -> Dictionary; pure candidate transform for A0's atomic harvest transaction.

offline_time_projection.integer_rule: All Unix timestamps, sequence, and world microseconds must be Godot int, not JSON-parsed float. A0 must cast/validate at the producer boundary.

fields.run_id: non-empty string <=96; must match armed records and needs projection
fields.interval_start_unix: int >= run_started_at_unix and >= durable offline high-water
fields.last_authenticated_unix: int; for an initialized run must equal durable offline.last_authenticated_unix; must be <= interval_start_unix

world_calendar.rule: end_world_us >= start_world_us; A3 reports delta only

stations.rule: owner_run_id must match; revision must equal armed record and live placed-station resolver; operational true and condition >0 for progress

plan_output.proposal_id: sha256(canonical(request) + policy_sha256 + canonical(survival_economy)); A0 idempotency key
plan_output.queue_rule: Per station, jobs are processed in sorted job-id order and share the interval sequentially, matching V5 advance. An unarmed or blocked predecessor blocks later jobs; no parallel station throughput is invented.
plan_output.expiry_rule: effective_end_unix = min(interval_end_unix, run_expires_at_unix). Post-expiry intervals propose zero work.

apply_rule: A0 must first check SaveService.is_transaction_applied(proposal_id). Inside transact_once, call apply_offline_operation_plan. It re-plans from the candidate, rejects stale_offline_proposal on drift, verifies escrow/policy/station/run, advances only remaining paid ticks, completes into existing job escrow, prunes completed arm records, and advances the durable high-water. It never reads proposal deltas as authority and never writes disk.

d059_food_forecast.authority: A0 owns satiety, HP, shelter validity, death, and the actual item debit. A3 only forecasts bounded debits against real SaveService bag/home-storage/container stock and approved food items.
d059_food_forecast.commit_rule: A0 must use forecast_id as its own idempotency key and re-check food_custody_sha256 before debiting. A3 does not commit food.

tool_use_callable.rule: A0 must apply_tool_use_plan inside the SAME SaveService transaction as node hit, depletion, and inventory grant. Full bag or failed save rejects the whole swing. yield_multiplier is always 1. active_seconds is an A0 echo, not an A3-verified clock.

player_value: A player who pays for two forge batches and arms them before an 18h absence returns to two iron ingots in job escrow. Those ingots plus saved oak/spares make a research kit affordable, turning the next expedition from repeated scrap grinding into a targeted learning choice. No loot table, Core, POI refresh, or free material is added.
